name: Björn Lindström
bio:
Björn Lindström's path to motorsport IT management was unconventional. After graduating with a degree in computer science, he spent several years developing software for the banking sector. While financially rewarding, the work lacked the passion Björn craved. A lifelong motorsport enthusiast, he volunteered at local rally events, eventually offering his IT expertise to improve timing and data analysis. This led to a role with a smaller racing team, where he honed his skills in a high-pressure environment. 

Now at Iron Lynx, Björn is responsible for maintaining the team's complex IT infrastructure, ensuring seamless data flow between trackside operations, the factory, and partners. He takes a methodical and results-oriented approach, prioritizing system stability and security. Björn's ability to troubleshoot under pressure and his deep understanding of motorsport data make him a valuable asset to the team. He is known for his insistence on rigorous testing and documentation, ensuring the team is always prepared for unexpected challenges.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted on the left
physical.description: Björn has a focused gaze and a slightly weathered face from spending time outdoors.

quirks: Insists on backing up all data at least twice.
Has a collection of vintage circuit board components on his desk.
